title: A paragraph with a drop cap
concept: DropCapCharacters and DropCapLines on a ParagraphStyleRange lift the leading characters into an enlarged initial spanning the named number of lines.

annotations.note: DropCapCharacters="1" sets how many leading characters become the drop cap; DropCapLines="3" sets how many lines tall it is.
DropCapDetail="0" carries InDesign's sizing/positioning detail; the renderer reads it alongside the two counts.
The first character of this Content becomes the drop cap; the rest of the run flows around it as body text.
